_comment: Manual overrides applied by seed-venues.py. Edit before re-running the seed.

aliases._comment: Map a raw venue string (case-insensitive, exact match) to a canonical slug. Use when a venue has zero/wrong address in some events and can't be auto-merged.

merges._comment: Force-merge two slugs. Format: 'loser-slug': 'winner-slug'. Loser's aliases + events fold into winner. Applied after auto-grouping.

venues._comment: Per-venue field overrides. Any field set here wins over auto-populated values.

splits._comment: Reserved: force-split a merged group if two real venues collided.
